mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate investments, which in turn depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when the FEDFUNDS rate increases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over the last two quarters indicates strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when GDPC1 shows sustained growth over two quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased consumer spending, driving up S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% within the last month signals a slowdown in economic activity, which can lead to reduced corporate earnings and investor pessimism, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO decreases by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% and retail sales (RSAFS) increase by more than 2% simultaneously within the last month, it signals strong consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% and RSAFS increases > 2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when both HOUST and RSAFS increase significantly.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in the last month, it signals a strong labor market, which can lead to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when UNRATE is below 4% and PAYEMS increases significantly.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in the last month, it signals inflationary pressure and monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS is above 4% and CPIAUCSL increases significantly.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, when industrial production (INDPRO) is above its 12-month moving average and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is rising, it signals a potential economic overheating, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average and FEDFUNDS is rising.
